blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of current V25 sit and crouch renders shows both shorts thighs remain visible while the apron hangs between or behind the legs; side hems lift around the knees. Front-panel deformation/attachment still fails continuous coverage.

Direct inspection of current V25 views: side folds descend more continuously and rear vertical channels are clearer than V24, but coarse triangular faceting persists across the right/rear skirt and front apron. Surface continuity remains unacceptable.
The rear adjustment tab still blends into the jacket and the buckle has no distinct readable shape in the current back view.
Authored UV mapping is still missing. The mesh topology illustration is not a UV layout.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
